Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: Technical report (GitHub PDF and Hugging Face paper page) and a release/technical blogpost are linked; base model Falcon-H1-7B-Base is on Hugging Face; TTS evaluated via DeepConf (external GitHub code). Inference is supported via transformers, vLLM and SGLang.
quotes: For more details about the training protocol of this model, please refer to the [Falcon-H1R technical blogpost](https://falcon-lm.github.io/blog/falcon-h1r-7b) and [Technical Report](https://github.com/tiiuae/falcon-h1r/blob/main/tech_report.pdf).
